idea-plugin.name: Ai Auto Commit Assistant
idea-plugin.description:
Ai Auto Commit Assistant generates clear Git commit messages from selected changes in the JetBrains Commit tool window.

Ai Auto Commit Assistant 基于 JetBrains Commit 工具窗口中已勾选的 Git 变更自动生成提交信息，支持 OpenAI 兼容接口。

  • Generate commit messages directly from the Commit tool window
  • Read only the changes currently selected for commit
  • Support custom channels, Base URL, API Key, and model selection
  • Fetch available models from OpenAI-compatible providers
  • Support Chinese / English output and multiple prompt templates
  • Store API keys securely with JetBrains PasswordSafe

action.description: Generate commit message with Ai Auto Commit Assistant
